setup_distributed_process_group: initialize a distributed process group using NCCL backend with TCP init method for multi-GPU training
distribute_model_object: wrap a PyTorch model in DistributedDataParallel or ApexDDP for multi-process distributed training
create_distributed_data_loader: create a DataLoader with DistributedSampler for training and VolumeSampler for validation in distributed settings
sync_distributed_barriers: synchronize all distributed processes at epoch boundaries and model save points using NCCL barriers
aggregate_distributed_stats: compute and all-reduce loss statistics across all distributed processes to get global averages
